gen-dafont-azonix-gf-sulphur-point: Commanding wide letters in Azonix hold their crispness at small sizes, while Sulphur Point sits beneath with a marker-like line. The standout is how crisp those wide shapes stay when shrunk.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-tiktok-sans: Wide, stern and wire-stroked, Azonix barely lifts its capitals above the height of its lowercase. And TikTok Sans runs tall in the x-height with a spacious c, so paragraphs of it feel open and easy going.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-ubuntu-sans: Azonix wears its capitals only slightly above the lowercase, in wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp even when shrunk. Ubuntu Sans adds big-eyed, pipe-like curves beneath it, so the page feels modern.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-vend-sans: Azonix keeps its capitals barely taller than its lowercase. It commands attention in wide crisp shapes, while Vend Sans does the quiet work with a ruler-drawn line and a tall x-height.
gen-dafont-bebas-kai-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and friendly, its lowercase nearly matching its caps. Stretched over pages it wears thin, which is why brief text suits it better, with the compact, pen-steady Bebas Kai doing the shouting.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-abeezee: Tall, pencil-sketched and precise, Blockletter holds one thickness from the first stroke to the last. And ABeeZee takes over with terminals that stop well short of the stem and a high mean line.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-anek-bangla: Blockletter draws every letter with the steadiness of a pulled string. That makes it a strong display voice, while Anek Bangla handles the reading with wide s curves and a short climb to the ascenders.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-anek-latin: Precise and pencil-steady, Blockletter draws every stroke at a single thickness, with a tall, belly-like midsection. Blockletter makes the statement; Anek Latin, the sans, keeps its tall lowercase open.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-anek-malayalam: Precise from the first stroke, Blockletter draws its letters like laid-out spaghetti. Blockletter makes the entrance, while Anek Malayalam keeps its lowercase near the caps and curve tips apart.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-anek-odia: Anek Odia keeps its rounds unsealed, like an unlatched hook. Blockletter, with its tall belly and no calligraphic modulation, loses its punch if made small, so let it stay large.
